title: Azure Backup & Recovery Engineering
domain: KEY VAULT / POSTGRESQL / BLOB / TERRAFORM STATE
subtitle: A backup must preserve the data, its keys and a tested recovery path.
scenario: Sensitive payroll records, uploaded documents and the engineering portal depend on different recovery mechanisms. A database copy alone cannot recover wrapped keys, files or runtime configuration.
outcome: Verify key-version coverage, reject changed backup bytes and restore only into owned isolated targets.
flow: Create backup only for changed coverage or age
Verify retained bytes and create-only receipt
Restore into a disposable target and check versions
Record partial failures and owned cleanup
notes: The key orchestration is extracted implementation code; the default transport is a fictional in-memory fixture.
PostgreSQL scripts are actual VM helpers; no cloud restore is executed by this screen.
SQL/document/state rehearsals have separate acceptance requirements and are not claimed as completed.
boundary: Actual recovery orchestration using fictional adapters; no Azure calls, real records or live cryptographic acceptance.
